loads X.npy (written in C6 from the full region for 1991-12-27..2003-01-05 plus all 92 target days), builds ±5-day index pools per day of year over baseline sea cells, takes the hazen 90th percentile, smooths it with a wrapping 31-day mean, and compares it with every target day's SST to build per-cell MHWs that are written to output/mhw_mask.nc. Because only smoothed thresholds for day of year 138–259 (June–August ±15 days) are indexed, only baseline values from May 12 to Sep 20 of each year 1992–2002 reach the mask; the climatology is unused."}
